mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.club_name FROM club_info c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.approval_status = 1 AND (#{allClubs} = 1 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM club_member cm WHERE cm.club_id = c.id AND cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.status = 1 AND cm.deleted = 0 )) ORDER BY c.id
mapper.sql: FROM member_points_log p JOIN club_member cm ON cm.club_id = p.club_id AND cm.user_id = p.user_id AND cm.status = 1 AND cm.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.status = 1 AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE p.club_id = #{clubId} GROUP BY p.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) AS club_total_points, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.created_at >= #{monthStart} AND p.created_at < #{monthEnd} THEN p.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS month_points, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.user_id) AS scored_member_count FROM member_points_log p LEFT JOIN club_member cm ON cm.club_id = p.club_id AND cm.user_id = p.user_id AND cm.status = 1 AND cm.deleted = 0 WHERE p.club_id = #{clubId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(points) AS points FROM member_points_log WHERE club_id = #{clubId} AND created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT reason, SUM(points) AS points, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM member_points_log WHERE club_id = #{clubId} GROUP BY reason ORDER BY points DESC, reason
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO member_points_log (club_id, user_id, points, reason, description, related_activity_id, related_checkin_id, created_at) VALUES
(#{item.clubId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.points}, #{item.reason}, #{item.description}, #{item.relatedActivityId}, #{item.relatedCheckinId}, NOW())
